codeReview.summary: The Tailwind migration covers the requested pages and the dashboard sign-out affordance was added, but the landing page CTA is not reliably auth-aware during session loading and the magic-code flow can auto-submit a stale OTP after the email is edited.

issues.description: `primaryCTA` is derived from `currentUser` alone while `currentUser` starts as `null` and the `/api/v1/auth/me` lookup is still in flight. On an authenticated visit the page initially renders the signed-out CTA (`/sign-up`) until the effect resolves, so the required auth-aware CTA can show the wrong label and destination if the user clicks immediately after load.

The auto-submit effect keys off `codeValue` and `normalizedEmail`, but changing the email input never clears the six entered digits or rebinds them to the newly requested address. If a user edits the pre-filled email after entering a code, the stale OTP can be auto-submitted against the new email address.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared architecture notes still document `/janus` as the main dashboard route, while this feature's requirements and user flow point signed-in users to `/get-started`. That stale route note likely contributed to the worker validating `/janus` instead of the intended entry route.
